name: EUR/USD & USD/JPY Fair Value Model — Rate Differential OLS
description: Fair-value model for EUR/USD using rolling OLS regression on the US–Germany 10Y yield spread, with a parallel USD/JPY model (US–Japan 10Y spread) for cross-pair dislocation comparison. Outputs include fair value overlays, deviation z-scores, scatter plots, and a summary table comparing both pairs.
source:
# =============================================================================
# EUR/USD & USD/JPY FAIR VALUE MODEL — RATE DIFFERENTIAL OLS
# =============================================================================
# Rolling OLS: FX = α + β × (US 10Y − Foreign 10Y)
# EUR/USD: wider US-Germany spread → lower EUR/USD (β negative)
# USD/JPY: wider US-Japan spread → higher USD/JPY (β positive)
# Cross-pair comparison: which pair is more dislocated from fair value?
# =============================================================================

# --- Data Sources ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
ts = index()

# --- Economic Indicators (yield data, forward-filled) ---
us10y_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="DGS10", use_alfred=False)()
de10y_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="IRLTLT01DEM156N", use_alfred=False)()
jp10y_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="IRLTLT01JPM156N", use_alfred=False)()

us10y = ffill(us10y_raw.result)
de10y = ffill(de10y_raw.result)
jp10y = ffill(jp10y_raw.result)

# --- Yield Spreads ---
eurusd_spread = us10y - de10y    # US 10Y minus Germany 10Y
usdjpy_spread = us10y - jp10y    # US 10Y minus Japan 10Y

# =============================================================================
# EUR/USD MODEL: Rolling OLS (window=252)
# =============================================================================
eur_ols = linear_fit(window=252)(x=eurusd_spread, y=close)
fair_value_eurusd = eur_ols.intercept + eur_ols.slope * eurusd_spread
deviation_eurusd = close - fair_value_eurusd
dev_zscore_eurusd = zscore(window=252)(deviation_eurusd)
dev_pct_eurusd = deviation_eurusd / fair_value_eurusd * 100

# =============================================================================
# USD/JPY MODEL: Rolling OLS (window=252) — replicated for comparison
# =============================================================================
jpy_ols = linear_fit(window=252)(x=usdjpy_spread, y=close)
fair_value_usdjpy = jpy_ols.intercept + jpy_ols.slope * usdjpy_spread
deviation_usdjpy = close - fair_value_usdjpy
dev_zscore_usdjpy = zscore(window=252)(deviation_usdjpy)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- Category 1: EUR/USD Fair Value Model ---

# Chart 1: EUR/USD Actual vs Fair Value
xy_lines(
    title='EUR/USD: Actual vs OLS Fair Value (252d Rolling)',
    category='1. EUR/USD Fair Value Model',
    y_axis_label='EUR/USD',
    y_axis_dp=4,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='EUR/USD Actual', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Fair Value (OLS)', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(close, fair_value_eurusd))

# Chart 2: Raw Deviation from Fair Value (area)
xy_lines(
    title='EUR/USD Deviation from Fair Value',
    category='1. EUR/USD Fair Value Model',
    y_axis_label='Deviation (points)',
    y_axis_dp=4,
    area=True,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Deviation', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=deviation_eurusd)

# --- Category 2: EUR/USD Reversion Signal ---

# Chart 3: Z-Score of Deviation (area)
xy_lines(
    title='EUR/USD Deviation Z-Score — Mean Reversion Signal',
    category='2. EUR/USD Reversion Signal',
    y_axis_label='Z-Score (σ)',
    y_axis_dp=2,
    area=True,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Deviation Z-Score', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=1.0, color=Color.Amber, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='+1σ'),
        ReferenceLine(value=-1.0, color=Color.Amber, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='-1σ'),
        ReferenceLine(value=2.0, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='+2σ'),
        ReferenceLine(value=-2.0, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='-2σ')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=dev_zscore_eurusd)

# Chart 4: Scatter — Yield Spread vs EUR/USD
xy_scatter(
    title='US-Germany 10Y Spread vs EUR/USD',
    category='2. EUR/USD Reversion Signal',
    x_axis_label='US-Germany 10Y Spread (%)',
    y_axis_label='EUR/USD',
    y_axis_dp=4,
    x_axis_dp=2,
    show_trend_line=True,
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='Daily Observations', color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x=eurusd_spread, y_values=close)

# --- Category 3: Cross-Pair Comparison ---

# Chart 5: Z-Scores of both pairs overlaid
xy_lines(
    title='Which Pair Is More Dislocated from Fair Value?',
    category='3. Cross-Pair Comparison',
    y_axis_label='Deviation Z-Score (σ)',
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='EUR/USD Z-Score', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='USD/JPY Z-Score', color=Color.Orange)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=2.0, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='+2σ'),
        ReferenceLine(value=-2.0, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='-2σ')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(dev_zscore_eurusd, dev_zscore_usdjpy))

# Chart 6: Yield Spreads overlaid
xy_lines(
    title='Rate Differentials: US-Germany vs US-Japan 10Y Spread',
    category='3. Cross-Pair Comparison',
    y_axis_label='10Y Yield Spread (%)',
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='US-Germany 10Y Spread', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='US-Japan 10Y Spread', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(eurusd_spread, usdjpy_spread))

# --- Category 4: Fair Value Summary ---

# Summary table: EUR/USD vs USD/JPY side by side
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Fair Value Model Summary',
        row_size=5,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Current Spot', 'Fair Value', 'Deviation (pts)', 'Deviation (% of FV)', 'Z-Score'],
        col_headers=['EUR/USD', 'USD/JPY'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_color=Color.Orange),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_color=Color.Orange),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_color=Color.Orange),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_color=Color.Orange),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_color=Color.Orange)
        ]
    ),
    category='4. Fair Value Summary',
    order=1
)(close, close, fair_value_eurusd, fair_value_usdjpy, deviation_eurusd, deviation_usdjpy, dev_pct_eurusd, dev_pct_eurusd, dev_zscore_eurusd, dev_zscore_usdjpy)
